sections.mechanism: Finite coordinate contractions and a uniform diagonal radius produce a common shortness threshold. A radial time profile gives a global C1 disk; polar integration bounds its Jacobian by radial and angular derivative products and yields zeta<eta/2 with area<eta. Relative smoothing supplies admissible disks for arbitrary null loops. Two opposite small collars plus epsilon-minimizers prove continuity on the null-loop set.
